## Loading in packages and data
```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)

homicides <- read_csv("C:/Users/Owner/OneDrive - Colostate/ERHS 535/Homeworks/Homework #5/Homework-5/data/homicide-data.csv")
```

## Re-creating the graph - Option 2
```{r}
baltimore_homicides <- homicides |> 
  filter(city == "Baltimore") |> 
  mutate(reported_date =ymd(reported_date)) |> 
  mutate(reported_date_month = floor_date(ymd(reported_date), unit = "month")) |> 
  mutate(reported_date_str = str_sub(reported_date_month, 6, 7),
         season = case_when(reported_date_str %in% 
                              c("11", "12", "01", "02", "03", "04") ~ "Winter", 
                            reported_date_str %in% 
                              c("05", "06", "07", "08", "09", "10")~ "Summer"))

monthly_homicides <- baltimore_homicides |> 
  count(reported_date_month, season)


ggplot(monthly_homicides, aes(x = reported_date_month, 
                              y = n))+
  geom_col(aes(fill = season))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Winter" = "lightskyblue2",
      "Summer" = "gray"))+
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.12, se = FALSE, 
              color = "blue",linewidth = 1.2)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2015-04-01"), linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "red",linewidth = 1)+
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2015-04-01"), 
           y = max(baltimore_homicides$count), 
           label = "Arrest of Freddie Grey",
           color = "white", vjust = -28, hjust = 1.1,
           lineheight = 0.9, size = 4)+
           theme_dark()
```
